finding: Normalization-equivalent key checks do not detect visually confusable identifiers such as Latin and Cyrillic lookalikes. UTS #39 confusable skeleton comparison is a separate semantic acceptance layer and must not mutate or replace the original signed object.

properties: requires a version header and optionally pins the expected Unicode version
records SHA-256 of the exact confusables data text
constructs NFD-based confusable skeletons from MA mappings
detects collisions only among sibling keys in the same object
does not mutate keys, values, or canonical evidence bytes
